limitations: Exploratory replay of the repository SGBlur YOLO11n baseline, not a replay of the exact source server model/version.

novelty_scope: Original 154-image lecture inventory, earlier 3745-picture/298-sequence discovery inventory, and initial 13 MobiData review records. Not all model pretraining data.

additional_10m_search.limits: Selected exploratory cases with partial assistant-proposed target boxes, not an exhaustive visual census or population metric. Source SGBlur-yolo11s annotations and the pinned local YOLO11n replay are separate evidence.
